mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 71 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. We are under a Waning Crescent moon, and if you are looking at the sky tonight, the International Space Station will be visible starting at 8:17 PM for five minutes. Look for it rising from the south southwest over Belleville, traveling toward the east northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison, and reaching about halfway up the sky.

In local news, the Verona Police Department has arrested 34-year-old Halla Nelson for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member following an investigation into an incident from 2019. Additionally, road work continues on Highway M with phase two construction beginning the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns, while the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward with upcoming bridge closures near Lincoln Street.

There is plenty happening in Verona this week. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Downtown Farmer's Market will be at Hometown Junction Park, and you can also check out yoga at Insight Wellness or trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they were informed of an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student, which led to the arrest of a Madison resident on September 4.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
